Building Margevia3 min read

A few things
worth knowing.

What can I try on this page?

You can switch between three sample invoices, compare their line items, mark discrepancies for follow-up and download the comparison. All records are fictional. No real documents are uploaded or processed.

Who is Margevia being designed for?

Purchasing, operations and finance teams at independent caterers and small restaurant groups, especially where supplier checks still involve several documents and spreadsheets.

Does a flagged amount mean money has been recovered?

No. A discrepancy is a prompt to investigate. Your team checks the underlying agreement and delivery, contacts the supplier and confirms any credit before treating it as recovered.

Can I connect my accounting software?

This preview does not connect to accounting systems. The comparison can be downloaded as a CSV. The right integrations will depend on the workflows confirmed during pilot discovery.

How would a pilot start?

Choose one team and a small set of suppliers. Agree on the checks that matter, the sample records needed and how results will be reviewed. Use the planner below to choose your team, first check and pilot size. Brief delivery is not open yet.
